Cultivar: the evidence

Cultivating You. A habit tracker where the day is a plant you feed and the year is a garden you can look back over.

Cultivar is built by one person, a licensed master social worker (LMSW) with three undergraduate and two graduate degrees. Every rule in the app comes from the research on this page: what a missed day costs, why there is no streak to lose, and why it asks how a habit felt and when it happened. Each finding carries a confidence tag, and the places where the evidence cuts against the app are marked rather than left out.

Cultivar is a habit tracker, not therapy and not a clinical tool. Nothing in the app or on this page is medical or mental-health advice.
